rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 11 "See the mechanism repeat in every phase": line 97 "your LinkedIn, the colleague-guide frame, strengths, the mirror-list and the site it wwrote last" is closest: "colleague-guide frame" is a loose name for the Phase 2 StoryBrand colleague-help section (lines 25-35), recap of session artifacts, so it resolves against the session. Harm (unresolvable referent) absent.

line 105 "[Cookbook for Agent System Design](...)" names its target by title; no "the opening lecture" / "earlier module" positional pointer in body. Harm (callback aimed at a file by position) absent.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 103 "between Phase 1 and Phase 6" resolve to chunks 1 and 9; line 97 "the site it wrote last" is a session artifact; line 105 "Recipe 1" names this exercise, not a missing beat. No "the X you did/caught" with a missing target.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 67 "Run this one. The debrief starts from the file it writes, and the agent waits for one answer from you." is closest to a muted-read cue; "this one" binds to the prompt on the same slide and the setup is verbed. No guess-before-reveal beat exists.
chunk 2 "Phase 2: Apply a framework you know" (lines 21-25) is thinnest; line 25 "The site isn't there to sell. A colleague who visits it should think ..." is a self-carrying claim, not a wait-state.

chunk 11 header line 93 "See the mechanism repeat in every phase" vs line 97 listing each phase's context: body supports header. chunk 6 header "Phase 4: Anti-branding, the mirror" is a label, gloss at line 53 "inverting what you're against"; not contradicted.

line 103 "The LLM didn't get better between Phase 1 and Phase 6. The context did." is a two-part contrast, not "Not X. Not Y. Z."; line 71 two parallel sentences, no triple; "Not buying a service. Not booking a call." sits inside the Phase 2 prompt fence. No superlatives, no number+retraction.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: lines 29/33/39 "beats" = StoryBrand's own term and the prompt's, communicating not smuggling; grep -nE "\b(surface|compendium|forcing function|mood|firing)\b" on body_numbered: 0 hits (body view greps CLEAN).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 1 "Phase 1: The boring baseline": lines 13-15 every step opens with a bolded whole sentence ("**Open your own LinkedIn profile in your browser.**", "**Drop your LinkedIn text into the prompt below, after the colon. Send as one message.**"), the named monoculture shape, not a task-sizing callout, LO list or menu. Also chunk 3 line 31 "**Name the framework, tune it, have the agent run it.**" (whole sentence, second bold after line 29) and chunk 6 line 55 same sentence bolded beside line 53 "**Invert the easy thing.**" (two bolds). Harm (bold diluted, no handle stands out) present.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Bold handles only (**Select all**, **StoryBrand**); leave step sentences and the framework-move line plain.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file ... → "slides: 12 ... oversized: 0"; grep -c "^## " body → 12 (lines 9,21,27,33,41,49,57,63,75,83,93,99). Exercise reaches the deck under .phase--exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file ... → "OK — 1 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent." Headers Phase 1-7 consecutive; line 103 Phase 1/6 resolve.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file ... → "OK — 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut." Line 15 "the prompt below" has its paste block in the same chunk.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.evidence: one in-body link line 105 names the document in link text ("Cookbook for Agent System Design"), sentence works stripped, no page-geometry location. Review surface, never a gate.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file ... → "slides: 12 limits: 210 words / 6 bullets oversized: 0 ✓ every slide is within limits".

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: headings lines 9,21,41,49,63,75,83 are phase labels; 27 "Name the framework and tune it", 33 "Keep yourself the protagonist, then run the beats", 57 "List what you hate, then invert it" are imperatives; 93 "See the mechanism repeat in every phase" and 99 "Take the context move past this site" are the recap/point slides (line 99 imperative). Closest: 93 declarative-leaning but a label; no claim owed.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 55 "**Name the framework, tune it, ask the agent to run it.**" is closest to class (a) restatement of line 31; stays inside because on the Phase 4 slide it tells the student Phase 4 repeats the Phase 2 move (an instruction, not doctrine re-announced). Line 73 "LLMs go easy on their own output..." adds a move (over-flag).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: git diff cf4fd816..HEAD -- file | grep -E "^[-+]##" → 0 lines: diff touches body lines 53 and 59 (prose) and maintainer block only; no ## header changed, so no retitled slide.
